name: BixBench
description: BixBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents in computational biology, featuring over 50 real-world biological data analysis scenarios with nearly 300 open-answer questions. It measures the ability of LLM agents to perform multi-step analytical tasks and interpret nuanced biological results.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark in computational biology that is gaining attention for realistic multi-step analysis tasks, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on practical biological data analysis and multi-step reasoning; current frontier models achieve low accuracy.
